definitions.E2:
The **Construction Management Bachelor of Technology** is a degree-completion program focused on construction-project management, technical, and interpersonal skills.

- **Format:** Full-time or part-time
- **Delivery:** In person at the Burnaby campus
- **Curriculum areas:** construction controls, organizational management, stakeholder engagement, management electives, Liberal Studies, and professional standards
- Example courses include **CMGT 7190 — Construction Planning and Controls**, **CMGT 7330 — Finance for Construction Managers**, and **CMGT 7535 — Leadership and Interpersonal Skills**.

Program details: https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/

If you want to assess admission eligibility, share your previous credential, GPA, and construction-industry experience.
definitions.E1: Not necessarily. The requirement is **at least 4 credits** from the approved management elective pool—not four courses. Because electives range from **1 to 3 credits**, the number of courses depends on your selections.
definitions.E3:
Yes. An external management course may count toward the **minimum 4-credit management elective requirement**, but it requires program approval.

Ask the Construction Management program to assess the course—providing its outline, institution, and credit value—before relying on it toward your requirement.

Program information: https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/
